## Outcome

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change is necessary.

## Evidence

- [ ] Regression tests fail before the fix and pass after it.
- [ ] Unit/integration/browser/static/style/security/package gates run; failures disclosed.
- [ ] No production data, credentials, private URLs or proprietary code/assets.
- [ ] Saved data, installation identifiers and public hooks preserved or migration tested.
- [ ] Added dependencies/assets have compatible licenses and recorded provenance.
- [ ] Docs/readme match tested behavior; hardware claims backed by actual hardware evidence.
